audit_scope: Native model adapter functionality and measured synthetic-video latency; browser workflow assessed separately.

model.name: CLIP semantic linear temporal development classifier
model.selection_basis: Strongest historical measured original-recording development baseline available locally; selected after repeated development comparisons.

measured_model_evaluation.protocol: Repeated out-of-fold development comparison with posthoc model selection

native_adapter_smoke.source: Generated moving coloured rectangles; no private footage

limitations: The native smoke establishes that the selected model, encoder and app adapter execute together; it does not measure classifier correctness.
The measured62.5% applies to repeatedly used original40 development recordings and cannot be presented as independent accuracy on custom or new videos.
The0.908-second timing applies to one two-second synthetic recording after encoder preload, not to arbitrary video lengths or cold process startup.
The adapter returns a whole-recording verdict and uncalibrated score; it supplies no verified violation types, timestamps or regulatory findings.
The runtime emitted nonfatal scikit-learn persistence-version warnings (training1.6.1, runtime1.9.0); the recorded smoke completed successfully.
This audit makes no claim that the browser upload, API job lifecycle or public deployment was tested.
